description:
Add Sieve data types to jmap-mail-types/src/sieve.rs behind the sieve feature flag.

WHAT: Create jmap-mail-types/src/sieve.rs with SieveScript, SieveCapability, SieveAccountCapability, SieveScriptProperty, JMAP_SIEVE_SCRIPTS_URI. Wire feature flag into Cargo.toml and lib.rs.

ALGORITHM:
1. Add sieve = [] to crate-jmap-mail-types/Cargo.toml [features].
2. Create crate-jmap-mail-types/src/sieve.rs:
   a. pub const JMAP_SIEVE_SCRIPTS_URI = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:sieve"
   b. SieveScript { id: Id, name: Option<String>, blob_id: Id, is_active: bool } — #[non_exhaustive] #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")] #[derive(Debug Clone PartialEq Eq Serialize Deserialize)]; name/blob_id use #[serde(skip_serializing_if="Option::is_none")]; impl SieveScript { pub fn new(id, blob_id, is_active) -> Self }
   c. SieveCapability { implementation: String } — #[non_exhaustive] #[derive(Debug Clone Serialize Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")]
   d. SieveAccountCapability { max_size_script_name: u64, max_size_script: Option<u64>, max_number_scripts: Option<u64>, max_number_redirects: Option<u64>, sieve_extensions: Vec<String>, notification_methods: Option<Vec<String>>, external_lists: Option<Vec<String>> } — #[non_exhaustive] same derives; Option fields use skip_serializing_if; pub fn new(...) constructor
   e. SieveScriptProperty enum { Id, Name, BlobId, IsActive } — #[derive(Debug Clone PartialEq Eq Hash)]
   f. impl JmapObject for SieveScript { const TYPE_NAME = "SieveScript"; type Property = SieveScriptProperty; }
   g. impl GetObject for SieveScript {}
   h. impl SetObject for SieveScript { type Patch = serde_json::Value; }
3. In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/lib.rs add (behind cfg(feature="sieve")):
   - #[cfg(feature="sieve")] pub mod sieve;
   - #[cfg(feature="sieve")] pub use sieve::{SieveScript, SieveCapability, SieveAccountCapability, SieveScriptProperty, JMAP_SIEVE_SCRIPTS_URI};

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- #[non_exhaustive] on every public struct — pub fn new(...) is the only construction path for external crates
- Every Option field: #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
- No .unwrap() or .expect() in library code
- No async, no tokio (types crate has no async deps)
- All serde attributes must match the spec camelCase wire names exactly

AGENT TEAM: Single implementer agent + single validator agent

TESTS: cargo check -p jmap-mail-types --features sieve must pass; cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-types --features sieve -- -D warnings must pass; cargo test -p jmap-mail-types --features sieve must pass; cargo build -p jmap-mail-types (no features) must still compile
design:
Types to add (all behind cfg(feature=sieve)):

SieveScript { id: Id, name: Option<String>, blob_id: Id, is_active: bool }  — #[serde(rename_all=camelCase)]

SieveCapability { implementation: String }  — server-level capability object (urn:ietf:params:jmap:sieve)

SieveAccountCapability { max_size_script_name: u64, max_size_script: Option<u64>, max_number_scripts: Option<u64>, max_number_redirects: Option<u64>, sieve_extensions: Vec<String>, notification_methods: Option<Vec<String>>, external_lists: Option<Vec<String>> }  — per-account capability

SieveScriptFilter { name: Option<String>, is_active: Option<bool> }  — FilterCondition for /query

SieveScriptSortProperty enum { Name, IsActive }

SieveSetRequest — standard SetRequest fields + on_success_activate_script: Option<Id> + on_success_deactivate_script: Option<bool>

SieveValidateRequest { account_id: Id, blob_id: Id }
SieveValidateResponse { account_id: Id, error: Option<SieveSetError> }

SieveSetErrorType variants: InvalidSieve, SieveIsActive (extends base SetErrorType)

JMAP_SIEVE_URI const = urtietf:params:jmap:sieve

Name validation: spec §2.1 forbids U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029. Add validate_sieve_name(s: &str) -> bool helper.
